Happiness & Patience

Part 1 · Warm-up Questions
1Are you a happy person?✓ written
Sample answer

Yes, most of the time I am happy. I have good health and kind people around me, so I feel good.

Yes, most of the time I am happy. I have good health and kind people around me, so I feel positive and grateful.

YOUR ANSWER
2When do you feel unhappy?✓ written
Sample answer

I feel unhappy when I am disappointed in myself. This can be hard, but it also helps me learn.

I feel unhappy when I am disappointed in myself. It can be hard, but it also motivates me to learn and improve.

YOUR ANSWER
3What makes you happy?✓ written
Sample answer

I feel happy when I learn new things and get better at them. It makes me feel good about myself.

I feel happy when I learn new things and get better at them. It gives me a sense of progress and makes me proud of myself.

YOUR ANSWER
4Are you an introvert or an extravert?✓ written
Sample answer

I am an extravert. I like meeting new people and talking to them. It gives me energy.

I am an extravert. I enjoy meeting new people and talking to them, and being around others gives me energy.

YOUR ANSWER
Part 2 · Discussion Questions
1Are kids patient nowadays?✓ written
Sample answer

No, I think many kids aren’t patient today. They want things fast because of phones and games. For example, my little cousin gets angry when a video is slow.

In my opinion, many kids are not very patient today. This is because they always get fast answers from phones and games, so waiting feels strange to them. For example, my little cousin gets angry if a video takes a few seconds to load.

YOUR ANSWER
2Should parents buy their kids everything they want?✓ written
Sample answer

No, parents shouldn’t buy everything because children must learn to wait. For example, parents can teach their children to save money before buying something they want.

I do not think parents should buy their kids everything they want. If children always get what they want, they do not learn the value of things. For example, a child who waits for a toy will enjoy it more than one who gets it right away.

YOUR ANSWER
3Do parents need to teach their children to be patient?✓ written
Sample answer

Yes, parents should teach patience. It helps children stay calm. For example, kids can learn to wait in a line.

Yes, I think parents must teach patience to their children. Patience helps kids stay calm when life is hard. For example, a child who can wait quietly in a line will find it easier to handle problems later.

YOUR ANSWER
4How do you control yourself when you really want something right away?✓ written
Sample answer

I usually wait and do something else. Then I can think clearly. For example, before I buy something expensive, I wait a few days.

When I want something right away, I try to do another activity to forget about it. This helps because I have time to think clearly. For example, before I buy something expensive, I wait a few days and think if I really need it.

YOUR ANSWER

Safety & Crime

Part 1 · Warm-up Questions
1Is it safe to live in your city?✓ written
Sample answer

Yes, my city is mostly safe. But safety depends on the place and time.

Yes, my city is mostly safe. However, safety depends on the area and the time of day.

YOUR ANSWER
2What types of crimes do you know?✓ written
Sample answer

I know different crimes, like stealing and fraud. There is also cybercrime, like stealing information online.

I know several types of crime, such as theft and fraud. There is also cybercrime, for example stealing personal information online.

YOUR ANSWER
3Is the nightlife dangerous in your city?✓ written
Sample answer

It can be a little risky at night in some places. But most busy areas are safe.

It can be a little risky at night in some areas. However, most busy places are safe.

YOUR ANSWER
4Have you ever seen a crime in real life?✓ written
Sample answer

No, I haven’t seen a serious crime in my life. I only heard about it from friends or the news.

No, I have not seen a serious crime. I only heard about it from friends or the news.

YOUR ANSWER
Part 2 · Discussion Questions
1How can we reduce crime in our country?✓ written
Sample answer

We can reduce crime with education and jobs. People with jobs do less crime. For example, sport clubs help young people spend their time more effectively.

I think we can reduce crime with better laws and more education. If people have jobs and understand right from wrong, they will not commit crimes. For example, countries with good youth programs often have less crime.

YOUR ANSWER
2Why do you think there is more crime in big cities than in small towns?✓ written
Sample answer

Big cities have more people. There is also a big gap between rich and poor. For example, big cities have more unemployment.

I think big cities have more crime because there are more people and more differences between rich and poor. This can cause stress and problems. For example, big cities often have more unemployment, which can lead to crime.

YOUR ANSWER
3What is cybercrime?✓ written
Sample answer

Cybercrime is crime on the internet. For example, some people get fake messages asking for their bank details.

Cybercrime means illegal actions on the internet, like stealing money or personal information. It is growing because more people use the internet now. For example, some people get fake messages asking for their bank details.

YOUR ANSWER
4Would you help a person if he/she were in a difficult situation?✓ written
Sample answer

Yes, I would help if it is safe. Kindness is very important. For example, if someone is lost, I would help to find directions or call for help.

Yes, I would help someone in a difficult situation if it is safe. I think kindness is important in life. For example, if I saw someone lost in the street, I would help them or call for help.

YOUR ANSWER
